result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"負向的 competitive_share_entrants#0/#1 已進 moat.threats 與 R1，YouTube/Prime/Peacock 份額與 contradictions 也接住；customer_second_source 不適用。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"supply_demand_durability 無負向 finding，判斷以結構性持久處理，且 bear 情境已寫成長熄火至 5–7%。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots","reason":"監管、關稅、替代技術、DOJ 皆有接住；但 capital_markets_pricing#0 的『Q3 指引低於共識』被用在 R4，而 7/16 指引與本季 Q3 實績（營收 128.7 億 vs 指引 128.6）關係未交代，且 geo_supply_chain/channel_business_model_shift 的 finding 未見處理，屬輕度漏接。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.market_wrong_reason_given","reason":"內容具體，但『共識 EPS 三個月未下修』與 FY1 EPS 可能含 28 億終止費（推論未證）並存，乾淨 PE 21–22 倍；裁決進場且 wait_for_price 為 null 並無矛盾，僅 market_wrong 依據略依賴被墊高的分母。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"customer_second_source 無查詢、customer_concentration_credit 查詢切題且判斷已交代客戶分散；程式判定為 🟢。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"reinvest_rate／roiic 有 formula_note 算式，endo_ceiling 17.5 < 共識 CAGR 21.7% 且 reasoning 有處理（營益率擴張與回購），空頭機率 30% 已因此提高；Bull/Base/Bear EPS 有實質價差；但 roiic 127%×13.8%≈17.5% 是淨利代 NOPAT 的代理值，口徑偏弱；scenario_meta 與 judgment 的 irr 11.2／ev5y 64.7 一致。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.fact_refs","reason":"引用的營運指標均為 Q3'26（2026-10-20）最新，區域數字與 Greg/Ted 2026-10-20 發言皆不舊於 latest_quarter_kpis。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"drift_watch 變動欄（asym_ratio、ev5y、irr、bull/bear 價、機率、max_dd、rearm_trigger、price）都有歸因條目；惟程式歸因的 Bear 價 48.75 與 scenario_meta 的 48.8 為四捨五入差，且 contradictions 內『前份基本面結論漂移』cause 為新證據並把裁決寫成程式重算，尚可接受。"}]
